rationale: This is the final iteration, so the design submitted here gets the unseen-track race and no later iteration can correct it. I am submitting the measured best design, iteration 8, unchanged. It scored 323.64 in iteration 8 and again in iteration 9, which confirms the simulator is deterministic for this design. Span 0.05 at kd 0.6 is the best raced point: oval finishes rose to 14 of 20 and s-bend line losses fell from 1.00 to 0.75 versus span 0.04. Every alternative I could test now is untested at this span. The 0.045 span, kd 0.55 and other single-variable changes could each lower the score, and an unseen track gives no means to check them. The 0.06 span cut losses but cost oval finishes, and sensor_size 0.016 and base_speed 1.3 both lowered the score, so those stay closed. Oval steering_oscillation of 0.40 is above the 0.32 caution level, but the score is the decisive measure and it held across both races. Expected result: a score near 323 on the development tracks, with the unseen-track result depending on how well this layout generalises. Hypotheses: (a) the oscillation comes from the wider span steering harder at kd 0.6, so it is a cost of the better score rather than a fault; (b) the sensing layout limits s-bend and slalom, not damping. Measurements wanted: per-track line_loss_events, max_error and steering_oscillation, plus oval completion and completion_time, to confirm the baseline and show whether the unseen track is limited by sensing or by damping.
